skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the concept of sustainable development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of sustainable development in the context of globalization, international integration, and climate change.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Constructing criteria for evaluating sustainable development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand how to construct evaluation criteria for sustainable development in Vietnam within the context of globalization, international integration, and climate change.
Analyze the current state of Vietnam's economic development process from the perspective of sustainable development.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Reading, writing, presenting, and debating skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Practice reading, writing, presenting, and debating skills related to the concepts and evaluation criteria of sustainable development.
Develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify and address issues related to sustainable development.
Develop self-directed learning skills to actively seek out knowledge through reading textbooks, attending lectures, participating in group discussions, and handling situations in class.
Develop collaborative work and leadership skills to effectively participate, coordinate, and lead in group activities.
